title: Visual Designer
jobDescription: Namma Yatri is a Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS) platform built to empower drivers and provide seamless, frictionless ride experiences for users. We’re not just another ride-hailing app, we’re reimagining urban mobility from the ground up, with drivers at the center and intuitive design as our backbone. We are looking for a Graphic Designer/Illustrator with a strong grasp of current digital creation tools, visual trends, and an inherent ﬂair for storytelling. You’ll design visuals that have a high impact from product/character illustrations and UI storytelling to marketing creatives and brand expressions. You’ll collaborate closely with a dynamic cross-functional team including Product Managers, Business Development , UI/UX Designers, Developers as well as folks from Content Marketing, Performance Marketing, Social Media, and Events. Your work will span product launches, campaigns, internal initiatives and user education helping bring ideas to life through compelling visuals. Roles and responsibilities: ● Turn Complex Ideas into Visuals: Understand how our brand works and create simple, easy-to-understand graphics like infographics, app banners, posters, app illustrations - while meeting deadlines and keeping the quality high. ● Design Icons and Illustrations: Create original icon sets and illustrations from start to ﬁnish. Come up with ideas, sketch different options, and make sure all visuals match the app or brand’s look and feel while exploring various styles. ● Design for the Right Audience: Learn deeply about the product and the people using it. Make visuals that grab attention, explain the message clearly and feel relevant to the audience. ● Use the Right Tools and Techniques: Work with the best-suited design tools and methods for the job. Stay updated on design trends and suggest better ways to work when needed. What we are looking for: ● Experience in creating high-ﬁdelity illustrations. ● Proﬁcient in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and Figma (vector-based tools). Knowledge of Adobe After Effects is a plus. ● Ability to leverage AI tools (such as Chat GPT, Google Gemini, Higgsﬁeld, or Adobe Fireﬂy) to streamline workﬂows, rapidly prototype concepts, and accelerate the creation of high-quality visual assets. ● Comfortable using other Adobe Creative Cloud tools. Familiarity with Procreate is valuable. ● Strong background in digital design. Print design experience is a plus. ● A solid portfolio showcasing creativity and storytelling through illustrations, sketches, infographics and graphic design. ● Creative mindset, takes ownership and has great communication and presentation skills.

title: Senior Administrative Assistant
jobDescription: About Moving Tech Moving Tech (Namma Yatri) is reimagining urban transport from the ground up — built on the open Beckn Protocol and integrated with India's ONDC network. We operate with a zero commission model for drivers and give communities, cooperatives, and governments the power to run their own mobility platforms. The result? 15 Cr+ rides, 8 lakh+ drivers, 2 Cr+ users, 25+ cities — and growing fast. Backed by Blume Ventures, Antler, and Google, our apps (Namma Yatri, Yatri Sathi, Kerala Savaari, Chennai One, Bharat Taxi, and more) are driving real impact for real people. The Role We're looking for a seasoned Senior Administrative Assistant to own and elevate our office operations. You'll be the backbone of a smooth-running workplace — leading vendors, mentoring the admin team, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. What You'll Do • Office Operations: Own office supplies, equipment inventory, and facility upkeep end-to-end. • Vendor Management: Lead vendor sourcing, contract negotiation, SLAs, and ongoing relationships. • Scheduling & Travel: Coordinate complex meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements for leadership. • Events: Plan and execute office functions and company-wide events, big and small. • Front Office Excellence: Set the standard for visitor experience — professional, warm, on point. • Escalation Handling: Be the go-to for resolving tricky inquiries and concerns quickly. • Budget Oversight: Track admin spend and find smarter, cost-efficient ways of working. • Mentorship: Guide and support junior administrative staff in their day-to-day. • Process Improvement: Continuously upgrade office systems, tools, and procedures. Who You Are • Bachelor's degree preferred; high school diploma or equivalent required • 4+ years of experience in administrative or office management, ideally with vendor or team-lead exposure • Advanced proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) • Strong leadership instincts with sharp organizational and time-management skills • Excellent written and verbal communication, comfortable engaging senior stakeholders • Cool under pressure — great at multitasking and prioritizing on the fly • High attention to detail and accuracy, without losing sight of the big picture • Deep familiarity with office management systems, procedures, and vendor negotiations Why Join Us? • Real Impact: Keep the engine room running for a team building mobility for millions. • Autonomy & Ownership: Freedom to redesign how office operations work, end to end. • Transparent Culture: Good ideas win — regardless of title or team. • Learning & Growth: Grow into a larger operations or facilities leadership role.

title: Product Manager
jobDescription: About Namma Yatri : Moving Tech (Namma Yatri) is an open-mobility infrastructure company—think of us as the AWS/Google Cloud for mobility. We enable communities, cooperatives, and governments to launch their own mobility apps on the Beckn Protocol and the ONDC network, with zero commission for drivers and utility pricing for riders. Our family of apps—Namma Yatri (Karnataka, TN), Yatri Sathi (West Bengal), Odisha Yatri, Kerala Savaari, Chennai One (public transit—MTC buses, Metro Rail & suburban trains), Bharat Taxi (government-backed cooperative cab service in Delhi NCR & Gujarat), and more—are transforming mobility by being people-first. We foster partnerships across Samaaj, Sarkaar, and Bazaar (Society, Government, and Business). With 15Cr+ transactions completed, 8 lakh+ drivers earning over ₹2,500 crore, 2Cr registered users, and presence across 25+ cities—from auto-rickshaws in Bengaluru to public buses in Chennai and inter-city cabs through Bharat Taxi—Moving Tech is leading the change in accessible, community-driven mobility solutions. Backed by Blume Ventures, Antler, and Google. • Website & Open Data: nammayatri.in • Open Source Codebase: github.com/nammayatri/nammayatri Company: movingtech.com About the Role: At Moving Tech, Product Managers own the product journey end-to-end, balancing product development, operations, and customer engagement. This is an opportunity to be a true creator, not just a coordinator. Can PMs become TRUE creators? Can they CODE? Can they Design? Can they analyze data programmatically? Can they deeply empathize with the users they’re building for? Yes, they can! At Moving Tech, PMs are empowered to upskill themselves and collaborate across teams, including Development, Design, Growth, Communications, Support, and Operations. PMs here don’t just write product specs—they actively participate in the creation process, ensuring specifications are practical and deliverable. The PM in the Age of AI We believe AI is the next S-curve, a phase transition on the scale of the microprocessor or the internet that will reprice everything. The cost of building software is collapsing, and the bar for real value is rising fast: the PMs who lead will be the ones who use AI to go faster, deeper, and broader. It is a new way of working. What used to be 10x PM work will become the baseline. Tool users must become tool builders. Spec writers, code writers. Specialists, generalists who move fluently across design, engineering, and growth. The PMs who thrive will be the ones who pair theory with hands-on building. What does not change is what we believe about building software: that it must create real value, exhibit supreme craft, and be reasoned from first principles. AI is a lever for these beliefs, and a means to deepen our understanding of the problems we solve and the solutions we build. Key Responsibilities: ● Own and drive the vision of the organization. ● Deeply understand and continuously improve knowledge in: Domain: Mobility Technology: Purescript, Haskell, TypeScript Design: Mobile UX/UI (using Figma, Figjam, Protopie) Data: User journey analysis and conversions (using SQL & data science tools) ● Deliver impactful results by leading hands-on involvement in product development, leading by example. ● Develop foundational solutions that address core problems. ● Collaborate and coordinate with stakeholders to craft optimal products. ● Continuously optimize the product development process for speed and quality Must-Have Qualities: ● Strong aspiration for value creation and quality. ● Genuine empathy for users and their needs. ● Patience and openness to learn challenging skills. ● A systematic problem-solving mindset. ● Proactive get-things-done attitude. ● Ability to balance big-picture and attention to detail. ● Self-motivation and drive. ● Persuasive, but not forceful—influence with respect. ● A giver attitude, always ready to contribute. Bonus Points For Prior Experience in: ● Technical skills: Programming and curiosity to understand systems. ● Design interests: A keen eye for UX and active interest in mobile design. ● People-centric approach: Purpose-driven and open to understanding users deeply. Willingness to experience products firsthand (e.g., driving an auto or cab using the driver app). Learning local languages. Engaging with the open-source community. Preferred Qualifications: ● MBA with an engineering or science background. ● Experience or eagerness to thrive in a high-energy startup environment. ● Prior Product Management experience is not mandatory.

title: Content Writer - Intern
jobDescription: Job Description – Content Writer (Intern) Department: Brand, Marketing & Communications Location: Kochi, Kerala Type: Paid Internship About Moving Tech Moving Tech, the company behind Kerala Savaari, is reimagining urban mobility through open, driver-first technology. Built on the open Beckn Protocol and integrated with India's ONDC network, our platforms empower drivers while giving riders a transparent, reliable, people-first experience. With 15 crore+ rides, 8 lakh+ drivers, 2 crore+ users, and operations across 25+ cities, Moving Tech creates meaningful impact through platforms such as Namma Yatri, Yatri Sathi, Kerala Savaari, Chennai One, Bharat Taxi, and more. About the Role We're looking for a versatile Content Writer Intern to be the voice – and face – of Namma Yatri's Kerala operations, helping riders and drivers understand the app, its services, benefits, updates and campaigns. This is a hands-on, in-house creative role for someone who brings sharp writing, on-camera confidence, and a genuine feel for Kerala's culture, Malayalam communication, and current digital trends. Key Responsibilities ● Write compelling copy in Malayalam and English for social creatives, app banners, pop-ups, digital ads and campaigns – explaining features, benefits, safety information and service updates. ● Develop campaign ideas, headlines, taglines, captions and creative concepts. ● Write scripts for reels, promos, explainers, interviews and community stories; present and appear on camera for app explainers, campaign content, interviews and event coverage. ● Conduct vox pops and conversations with riders, drivers and community members; support video shoots through content planning, scripting and presentation. ● Write content for event branding, print materials, posters, standees and other offline communication. ● Adapt content into platform-specific formats while maintaining a consistent brand voice; write and proofread Malayalam and English copy for clarity, grammar and accuracy. ● Translate Kerala's trends, cultural moments, local humour and regional insights into relevant content ideas, using AI- powered tools to sharpen creative output. ● Collaborate with designers, product, operations and marketing teams while managing multiple content requirements and deadlines Skills We're Looking For Clear communication in Malayalam and English, with a strong understanding of audience needs and the ability to adapt messaging across platforms. A strong sense of storytelling, attention to detail, and confidence engaging with people are essential, along with real fluency in Kerala's culture, Malayalam pop culture, local humour and current digital trends. Familiarity with AI-assisted tools and modern creative workflows is preferred. Qualifications & Eligibility ● Bachelor's or Master's degree in Visual Media, Visual Communication, Journalism, Mass Communication, Media Studies, or related field. ● Prior internship or relevant hands-on project experience preferred. ● Proficiency in Malayalam and English, with strong knowledge of Kerala's culture and current trends. ● Ability to convert communication requirements into clear, engaging ideas, and manage multiple projects independently. ● Strong creative thinking, attention to detail, communication and collaboration skills. ● Relevant work samples or a portfolio are mandatory. How to Apply Share your updated CV and portfolio – including relevant written work and videos featuring you on camera – while applying.

title: Content Editor & Cameraman - Intern
jobDescription: Job Description – Content Editor & Cameraman (Intern) Department: Brand, Marketing & Communications Location: Kochi, Kerala Type: Paid Internship About Moving Tech Moving Tech, the company behind Kerala Savaari, is reimagining urban mobility through open, driver-first technology. Built on the open Beckn Protocol and integrated with India's ONDC network, our platforms empower drivers while giving riders a transparent, reliable, people-first experience. With 15 crore+ rides, 8 lakh+ drivers, 2 crore+ users, and operations across 25+ cities, MovinTech creates meaningful impact through platforms such as Namma Yatri, Yatri Sathi, Kerala Savaari, Chennai One, Bharat Taxi, and more. About the Role We're looking for a versatile Content Editor & Cameraman Intern to shoot and craft video content for Namma Yatri's Kerala operations – capturing footage on the ground and cutting it into content that helps riders and drivers understand the app, its services, benefits, updates and campaigns. This is a hands-on, in-house creative role for someone who's as comfortable behind the camera as behind the editing timeline, with a sharp eye, steady hands, and a genuine feel for Kerala's culture, Malayalam communication, and current digital trends. Key Responsibilities ● Shoot footage for reels, promos, explainers, interviews, vox pops and event coverage – camera operation, framing, lighting and on-site audio. ● Edit reels, promos, explainers, interviews and event coverage into polished, platform-ready content, with subtitles, music, sound effects and titles. ● Perform colour correction, colour grading and basic audio cleanup; produce simple motion graphics and transitions where needed. ● Accurately place and proofread Malayalam and English text in subtitles and on-screen graphics; adapt every video into platform-specific sizes and formats. ● Translate Kerala's trends and local humour into relevant shoot and edit ideas, using AI powered tools to speed up the workflow. ● Collaborate with content creators, presenters, product, operations and marketing teams while managing multiple shoots and edits against deadlines. ● Occasionally appear on camera for behind-the-scenes and creative content when required. Skills We're Looking For Hands-on camera operation – framing, lighting and on-site audio capture – paired with strong editing chops in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects and/or DaVinci Resolve. A sharp sense of pacing, composition and visual storytelling is essential, along with real fluency in Kerala's culture, Malayalam pop culture, local humour and current digital trends. Familiarity with AI assisted tools and modern creative workflows is preferred. Qualifications & Eligibility ● Bachelor's or Master's degree in Visual Media, Film, Mass Communication, Media Studies, or related field. ● Prior internship or relevant hands-on project experience preferred. ● Proficiency in Malayalam and English, with strong knowledge of Kerala's culture and current trends. ● Comfortable operating a camera on shoots, and appearing in front of one when required. ● Ability to work independently and manage multiple shoots and edits at once. ● Strong creative thinking, attention to detail, communication and collaboration skills. ● A portfolio or reel of relevant camera and editing work is mandatory. How to Apply Share your updated CV and portfolio – including a reel that showcases your camera work and edits – while applying.
